statements.statement: The member has documented recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The member has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The member has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring is indicated to correlate the episodes with potential arrhythmic events and evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The submitted claim is for CPT 93247
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
Precertification was not required to be obtained before the service given the documented clinical presentation
